key_insight: Decoupling operating duration from flow decisions enables PPO to generate efficient multiproduct pipeline schedules while preserving nonlinear hydraulic fidelity.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets demand-compliant pipeline operations with steadier flow rates and shorter scheduling computation times.
method: Model scheduling as a semi-Markov decision process with flexible action durations.
Use cascaded PPO actors for discrete operating duration and continuous flow decisions.
Decouple action learning to reduce destabilizing gradient interference.
evidence_signal: On a real-world pipeline in China, comparisons with a single-actor baseline and a Gurobi-solved linearized MILP show reported near-optimal delivery accuracy, improved flow stability, and reduced solution time.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative gains or evidence of generalization beyond the evaluated pipeline.
paper_title: Efficient Detailed Scheduling of Multiproduct Pipelines using Action-Decoupled Deep Reinforcement Learning
